scope: Independent visual reading of canonical-base.png, contact-sheet.png and every frame in all nine standard action sequence PNGs
identity: Consistent mint teal long wavy hair, green eyes, swept fringe, white collar and cuffs, thin red bow, tan double-breasted uniform and pleated skirt, visible knees above dark socks, brown loafers. Side views retain the approved identity.

rows.name: idle
rows.notes: All six frames complete. Small breathing variation and half-close/full-close blink, stable scale and baseline.

rows.name: running-right
rows.notes: All eight frames face screen right; hair trails left. Extended stride and tucked recovery poses form a readable running cycle. Some extended poses are similar, but limbs move and silhouette remains complete.

rows.name: running-left
rows.notes: All eight frames face screen left; hair trails right. Extended and recovery leg positions alternate. Feet, hands and hair stay within their cells.

rows.name: waving
rows.notes: Four complete front-view frames: arms down, raised open palm, changed palm angle, return. Same identity and scale.

rows.name: jumping
rows.notes: Five complete frames show lowered preparation, rise, highest central pose with bent legs, descent and lowered landing. Apparent head baseline moves vertically as intended, without conspicuous horizontal drift.

rows.name: failed
rows.notes: Eight complete frames move from neutral through lowered eyelids and bowed head to recovery. Downcast expression reads as disappointment. No prop or body deformation.

rows.name: waiting
rows.notes: Six complete frames hold both open palms forward/up, change hands, small head tilt and mouth expression, then return. Reads as expectant waiting.

rows.name: running
rows.notes: Six complete thinking frames: one hand at chin with opposite arm supporting, blink and slight head motion. Correct thinking semantics despite internal row label running.

rows.name: review
rows.notes: Six complete frames perform a small head tilt and downward/blinking inspection, then return. No added objects or accessories. Distinct from chin-touch thinking row.

integrity: No obvious missing internal character regions, accidental transparent-looking cracks, clipped extremities, duplicated detached parts or abrupt proportional changes visible in the inspected sequences. Gray external gaps between limbs/hair read as natural negative space.
limitations: Magenta/white edge speckles are present before final chroma cleanup and were explicitly excluded as a failure criterion. Alpha integrity and edge color must be rechecked after final cleanup; this visual pass does not claim pixel-level alpha validation or native-app playback.
recommendations: Recheck all nine rows against light and dark backgrounds after despill/alpha cleanup.
